name: The PJs
description: Thurgood Stubbs lives with his wife, Muriel, in the Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs housing project, where he is the superintendent. This animated comedy follows the adventures of the Subbs and their friends, while taking a satirical view of the ups and downs of life in a big-city housing project.

videos.title: Hangin' with Mr. Super
videos.overview: Thurgood, upset with a truant child, decides to teach the boy responsibility, but his efforts backfire.

videos.title: Bones, Bugs and Harmony
videos.overview: Thurgood's suspicion that Mrs. Avery is starving prompts him to help her out, but Muriel thinks he's being used for different reasons.

videos.title: The Door
videos.overview: When Thurgood is slammed with complaints from the tenants about the building's front door, he seeks aid from HUD.

videos.title: Journal Fever
videos.overview: When Muriel falls ill, Thurgood fails his wife by falling asleep when she needed to be taken to the hospital.

videos.title: Rich Man, Porn Man
videos.overview: Thurgood is aghast when his clean-up project for the movie theater leads to the venue's resurrection as a porn cinema.

videos.title: Bougie Nights
videos.overview: Thurgood and Muriel move into the building's penthouse, but they can't seem to adjust to life at the top.

videos.title: A Hero Ain't Nothing But a Super
videos.overview: Muriel's heroic capture of a prowler in the Stubbs' home turns Thurgood into a hero when he assumes credit for the deed.

videos.title: He's Gotta Have It
videos.overview: The experimental medication prescribed for Thurgood's blood pressure also jump-starts his sex drive.

videos.title: Boyz' N the Woods
videos.overview: When Calvin and Juicy miss the chance to go on a camping trip, Thurgood takes them on an overnighter in their neighborhood, and he loses track of the boys.

videos.title: Operation Gumbo Drop
videos.overview: Thurgood's culinary pride takes a blow when his gumbo recipe fails to measure up to the one prepared by an unlikely rival--Juicy.

videos.title: U Go Kart
videos.overview: After building a go-cart for Calvin and Juicy, Thurgood accidentally destroys it and buries the evidence, so it appears to have been stolen. Then he's put in charge of the investigation.

videos.title: House Potty
videos.overview: The building's new power-flush toilet frees Thurgood from clogging calls, and may end all need for him.

videos.title: Haiti Sings the Blues
videos.overview: Neighbors treat Thurgood like the plague after Haiti Lady puts a curse on him following their row in the new community rooftop vegetable garden.

videos.title: How The Super Stoled Christmas
videos.overview: Thurgood takes a job as a repo man to raise money for the computer Muriel wants for Christmas.

videos.title: Home School Dazed
videos.overview: During a teachers' strike, Thurgood joins Juicy and Calvin in home schooling after it's revealed he never got his diploma.

videos.title: The Postman's Always Shot Twice
videos.overview: The Stubbses take in Mrs. Avery after authorities threaten to send her to a rest home following her shotgun attack on the mailman.

videos.title: The Preacher's Life
videos.overview: Thurgood undergoes a religious transformation after receiving an electrical shock, followed by a vision of a black Jesus. So, he decides to become a preacher.

videos.title: The HJs
videos.overview: Thurgood revives the project's defunct radio station, and it takes off after he and Smokey inadvertently form a comedy team. But Smokey proves to be more popular, and that doesn't help Thurgood's ego.

videos.title: Haiti and the Tramp
videos.overview: Matchmaker Muriel pairs Haiti Lady with Walter. They fight like cats and dogs, which acts like a mutual aphrodisiac. But that may be the extent of their relationship.

videos.title: Smokey the Squatter
videos.overview: The law's on Smokey's side when he claims squatter's rights after Thurgood lets him spend a night in a vacant apartment to ride out a storm.

videos.title: Weave's Have A Dream
videos.overview: Thurgood turns the boiler room into a beauty shop for Muriel, whose gossip doesn't match Bebe's--until she dishes dirt on Thurgood.

videos.title: Let's Get Ready To Crumble
videos.overview: A former wrestler-turned-politician comes to help Juicy after Thurgood's demonstration of his wrestling moves puts the boy in a bind.

videos.title: Who Da Boss?
videos.overview: Thurgood wants Jimmy hired to replace his late (and lax) supervisor. But a group effort to fill out the application backfires, and Thurgood's new boss is...bossy.

videos.title: Fear of a Black Rat
videos.overview: After capturing a thieving rat, Thurgood enters the rodent in the Friday night rat fights, where their success is short-lived.

videos.title: Ghetto Superstars
videos.overview: Snoop Dogg plays a rap artist whose interest in the rhymes of Calvin and Juicy prompt Thurgood to become their manager.

videos.title: What's Eating Juicy Hudson?
videos.overview: Stressed from caring for his parents, Juicy finds solace building a treehouse with Thurgood, who becomes mediator between boy and father.

videos.title: The Jeffersons
videos.overview: After Muriel finds he's a descendant of Thomas Jefferson, Thurgood decides to run for political office, but his ideals are compromised by some shady new "friends."

videos.title: Robbin' HUD
videos.overview: When HUD refuses to grant the building a new water filter, Thurgood and the tenants break into the office to steal one, but find something else even more valuable.

videos.title: Cliffhangin' With Mr. Super
videos.overview: Thurgood is unsure of the facts when he wakes up with Bebe after a night of heavy drinking.

videos.title: The Last Affirmative Action Hero
videos.overview: Jackie Chan guest stars as his film shoots in the neighborhood. Thurgood is made responsible for protecting the area's image in the movie.

videos.title: A Parole Officer and a Gentleman
videos.overview: Walter arranges a brief jail stay to get free dental care for Thurgood, who assaults the dentist and lands on probation, overseen by Walter.

videos.title: Boyz Under The Hood
videos.overview: Calvin is jealous of Juicy knowing more about cars than him.

videos.title: Scarthroat
videos.overview: Sanchez lords over the distribution of victuals   after New Year's Eve brings a power outage and food   shortage to the Hilton-Jacobs Projects...from TV Guide.

videos.title: Smoke Gets In Your High-Rise
videos.overview: Thurgood makes a deal to place a cigarette advertisement on the side of the Hilton-Jacobs building in exchange for free air-conditioning.

videos.title: National Buffoon's European Vacation
videos.overview: From TV Guide   ""Thurgood balks at telling Muriel of Juicy's crush on her, since she thinks all of Juicy's thoughtful presents to her are from her husband.""

videos.title: Cruising For A Bluesing
videos.overview: From TV Guide   ""Would-be bluesmen Thurgood, Walter, Jimmy and Sanchez get stranded in the urban wastelands of the South South Side on the way to the gig of their dreams.""

videos.title: It Takes A Thurgood
videos.overview: From TV Guide:    Thurgood fears his job is at risk when he discovers a homeless teen-ager living in the boiler room.

videos.title: Miracle Cleaner On 134th Street
videos.overview: From TV Guide:   ""To warn Sharique of the dangers of being an entrepreneur in the projects, Thurgood tells her about a cleaning solution he invented, Formula Forty-O Nine, and how a big corporation tried to take advantage of his accidental brilliance.""

videos.title: Survival: In Tha Hood
videos.overview: From TV Guide:   ""Residents of the Hilton-Jacobs Projects are split into two rival tribes--one led by Muriel and one by Thurgood--for a televised competition, Survival: In tha Hood, sponsored by H.U.D.""

videos.title: Let's Get Ready To Rumba
videos.overview: From TV Guide:   Mrs. Avery's new zest for life after surviving a heart attack leads her to challenge champs Bebe and Jimmy in a local dance contest. Meanwhile, Thurgood refuses to enter the competition with Muriel.

videos.title: A Race To His Credit
videos.overview: Thurgood gets accepted for a new credit card, but his complete ignorance as to how credit works gets him buried in debt.

videos.title: Red Man's Burden
videos.overview: Jimmy cashes in on his American Indian ancestry when he opens a casino in the projects.

videos.title: Clip Show
videos.overview: Thurgood describes his life to a interviewer about life in the projects,while clips from previous episodes are shown.

awards: Won 3 Primetime Emmys. 5 wins & 8 nominations total
